_about: Rules every ontology inherits. `kind: derive` adds facts marked as derived, with the rule and the premises; `kind: policy` flags what a policy forbids. Never fill validated_by yourself.

then.flag: asserted as a plan more than 90 days ago and still not observed: record the action's run that realised it, or retire the intent

rules.why: An intended fact is a promise the graph makes about the world. A promise nobody has checked in three months is either kept and unrecorded, or broken; either way a reader must not take it as a plan still in motion.
